Asset note
----------
The English word list, picture cards, and local MP3 files are the originals
shipped in this project by gabriellji. They are redistributed here unchanged.
Filenames that include toppng.com and kisspng keep those source marks.
This repository's package.json declares ISC and does not forbid publishing.
The picture and audio files are not separately relicensed by this notice.
